pages.raw_meta: 100% Awesome scrubs start from the fiber up. Discover our obsession with fabric technology, innovation, and comfort that helps you look, feel, and perform your best 24/7.
raw_blocks: The highest standards didn’t exist—so we created them. Our collection of versatile, high-performance technical fabrics are designed for around-the-clock comfort and durability.
A versatile fabric designed for do-it-all durability. Advanced technical stretch meets stylish structure.
The fabric that started it all, engineered for everyday excellence. Lightweight, breathable, and ridiculously soft.
An elevated fabric crafted for high-performance polish and support. Sculptural stretch meets refined all-day comfort.
Airy knit piqué designed for effortless performance. Soft, structured, and durable, with made-to-move stretch.
The only thing that should come between you and your FIGS is an underscrub (also from FIGS).
This textured knit delivers the perfect dose of stretch, contouring, and cozy. Moisture-wicking nylon makes it a go-to for super active days.
Stay comfy even when the pressure heats up with built-in ventilation and odor-blocking Ionic+™ Nylon antimicrobial technology.
An airy base made from the finest modal and pima cotton. The premium fabric blend is feather-soft and a hardworking layer under scrubs.
Stay toasty even in a frigid OR with outerwear that comes in a variety of styles—so you’re always at the perfect temp.
Mega warmth goes ultra refined. Plush and richly textured bouclé on the outside, supremely soft microfleece on the inside.
100% recycled fleece gives you all the warm and fuzzies with an ultra-plush pile. Its durability and easy-care design are a bonus.
The ultimate flex. Stretchy warmth with a super soft brushed interior provides zero restrictions and 100% Awesome.
Warmth minus the bulk. Lightweight thermal insulation gives you a toasty yet breathable hug, so you never notice when the A/C is on full blast.
Beat the chill with fully functional warmth. Our super soft fleece features a water-repellent coating so you stay warm and dry.
All warmth. No weight. Our FLOAT™ outerwear keeps you super warm and is light as a feather.
